proposalRationale:
TJR stop placement: beyond the swing extreme the entry is taken against.

CLASSIFICATION: SOURCE-STATED as to DIRECTION and ANCHOR; UNKNOWN as to DISTANCE. 2 supporting
evidence items, 0 contradicting.

MECHANICAL SPECIFICATION (partial, and deliberately not completed): for a long entry the stop is
placed below the low of the swing the entry is taken against; for a short entry, above the high.
The anchor level is located by the structure-point rule in the companion candidate for
CLAIM|TJR|20260727|065, i.e. at the wick extreme, so: longStop = swingLow - delta,
shortStop = swingHigh + delta.

DATA REQUIRED: OHLC series at the entry timeframe (one-minute per CLAIM|TJR|20260727|027) plus the
identified swing the entry is taken against.

FALSIFICATION: this candidate is falsifiable on direction and anchor independently of delta. If
any charted TJR example places a long stop ABOVE the entry swing low, or anchors the stop to a
level other than the swing being traded against (e.g. a fixed point/ATR distance unrelated to
structure), the claim is refuted. Delta cannot be falsified until it is specified -- see UNKNOWN.

BLOCKING UNKNOWN -- delta is not stated anywhere in the corpus. "Beyond" is directional, not
metric. No source states a tick buffer, a percentage, an ATR multiple, or "at the wick tip
exactly". This single missing number makes the rule non-executable: it determines stop distance,
therefore position size for any fixed-fractional risk model, therefore realised risk-to-reward,
therefore every performance figure the strategy would be judged on. This is recorded as a gap and
must NOT be filled by choosing a plausible default. A delta of zero (stop exactly at the wick) is
a guess, not a reading of the evidence.

FURTHER UNKNOWN: (a) which swing "the entry is taken against" refers to when several swings exist
between the sweep and the entry -- the corpus does not disambiguate; (b) whether the stop is ever
moved before break-even (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|030 states the runner is left to stop at break even,
but not when it is moved there, nor after which take-profit level).
